name: smwgraphics-somari-rings
title: Somari - Rings
description:
That's an update for the Somari Rings submission (firstly submitted by KaidenThelens and updated by Hammerer (me)).

This update includes some notable changes, like:

1. The gfx for the rings was modified, now it looks more like the Somari rings ripped.
2. Added the ring graphics in GFX01 (for the coin animation when hit blocks), something missed in the first submission, along with the ring palette in palette row A for the coin sprites (it replaces the last 3 color slots (AD, AE and AF))
NOTE: The tile EA is slighter than the GFX33 version, since it was necessary to reduce the tile size to fit in the 8x8 space.
3. The blue palette in row 7 is different now, with shades that match best with the original palette (in row 6).
4. There's now the option to modify also the coin tile used in status bar, replacing it with the ring miniature in Sumari's status bar. I've included two ways to do that:

Way 1 (still): Using the tile 2E included in the submission's GFX28;

Way 2 (animated): Using ExAnimation to replace the original tile 2E in GFX28 with an animation similar to the coin animation in Sumari's status bar.

For this, the submission includes a mwl file with the exanimation (it's in the level exanimation option - you can change it to the global exanimation option if you want without problems) and a ExGFX file to be inserted in AN2 slot (you can set the exanimation to use alternate ExGFX file instead of using AN2, name the file with 60-63 for it).
NOTE: It will also change the collected Dragon/Yoshi Coin graphics in the status bar, as SMW uses the same tile for both!
5. You may want to use Tweaker tool to change the palette row used by sprites 45 (directional coin) and 7E (flying coin) from 8 and C to A.
Description from the first version of the submission:

Rings from Somari. That's about it.
